Magnusson Darby 48" provides steady, accurate levelling and ruling off across plaster and render surfaces. Features a 1219 x 95mm extruded aluminium blade, keeping weight low while maintaining strength for consistent straightening over wide areas. A detachable soft-grip aluminium handle offers stable control, supported by a sponge rubber callus protector to reduce hand strain during long shifts. Provides reliable guidance on demanding site work where durable, lightweight tools are essential.
